info.title: Spendeazy REST API
info.description: The Spendeazy REST API serves financial data in authorized Personal and Shared Spaces through explicit Space-scoped routes. Expenses, Categories, Budgets, Category Rules, and Statement Imports belong to a Space. Expense Added By and Statement Import importer fields preserve actor attribution without changing Space ownership. Bigint identifiers and counts, decimal money, domain dates, and UTC timestamps use the encodings described by the schemas below.

fileName.description: Statement file name retained after trimming.

statementDate.description: Credit Card statement date; null for E-Wallet imports.

accountFormat.description: Account format retained after trimming, or null when it does not apply.

historyFromDate.description: Inclusive E-Wallet history start date; null for Credit Card imports.

historyToDate.description: Inclusive E-Wallet history end date; null for Credit Card imports.

totalDebit.description: Original non-negative E-Wallet Total Debit control; null for Credit Card imports or legacy imports where this control is unavailable.

importedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Statement import was committed.

importedByUserId.description: Positive bigint User identifier for the actor who confirmed this Statement Import. It is immutable actor attribution; the Committed Statement Import belongs to its Space.

StatementImportResponseDto.description: A committed Statement Import belonging to the destination Space. The User who confirmed it remains the importer actor. Client file hashes and persistence fields are not returned.

id.description: Positive bigint Statement import identifier encoded as a string.

fileName.description: Statement file name retained after trimming.

statementDate.description: Credit Card statement date; null for E-Wallet imports.

accountFormat.description: Account format retained after trimming, or null when it does not apply.

expenseCount.description: Non-negative current Expense count encoded as a string.

StatementImportHistoryResponseDto.description: A Statement import in the destination Space history collection, including its current Expense count.

items.description: Statement imports ordered by confirmation time (importedAt) descending, then Statement import ID descending.

nextCursor.description: Opaque base64url cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results. A cursor must be reused with the same date filters; page size is not part of the cursor.

StatementImportHistoryPageResponseDto.description: A keyset-paginated Statement import history page. Items are ordered by confirmation time descending, then Statement import ID descending.

code.description: The sender-only Invite Code. It is grouped for human entry and is never placed in a URL.
The Invite Code entered by the authenticated User. Case and grouping separators are normalized by the API.

UnauthenticatedError.description: The request does not include valid Clerk session credentials.
